# RBAC route matrix

Catalogue version: **1**. One row per operation of openapi.yaml, one column per caller: no credential, each seeded role (an operator role first without, then with a verified second factor: `<ROLE>+mfa`), an expired bearer, a valid and an unknown refresh cookie, a valid and an unknown guest quote token, and on signature routes a provider signature with and without the route's permission (US-071, ADR-0008 am. 4 and 5, D-ARCH-107/109/110). The `rbac-matrix` suite runs every cell through the API pipeline; CI fails when this file differs from the generator output.

Cells: `Y` allowed; `401` AUTH_REQUIRED; `403` AUTHZ_DENIED (permission gate); `MFA` AUTHZ_DENIED (staff MFA gate); `-` not applicable. A caller whose credential the route does not accept gets the `none` cell (D-ARCH-109).
